name: @playform/ets-plugin-dsh-route
description: The routing-enforcer plugin: a DeepHarness plugin that enforces the user's model-routing policy SILENTLY on every subagent launch. The choice happens automatically - no prompting, no reminder, no orchestrator awareness. When a launch omits provider/model/reasoningEffort the plugin resolves the route per the user's policy (the task-type rules of the task-routing skill: exploration always GLM low; coding GLM low/high; planning and advanced debugging DeepSeek max) and injects it into the launch; the orchestrator's call succeeds exactly as if it had passed the right values. An explicit-but-wrong route is CORRECTED silently per the policy (the user's configuration is the law) and the correction is logged to the plugin's own ledger, never surfaced. The task-type inference applies a documented keyword table (Variable/Keywords) when the launch does not declare a role; the user's policy overrides it. The escalation path (the attempts ladder: GLM attempts, then one DeepSeek max re-dispatch with the artifacts) is also automatic and silent. Every resolved route is recorded in the plugin's ledger (the launch, the task type, the resolved triple, the explicit-or-resolved and corrected-or-kept flags) for the user's audit. The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture: it never appears in the profile's bundles and enables only by an explicit ACTIVATE. Plan: Documentation/Plans/ROUTING-ENFORCER-PLUGIN.md.
